title: Tata Steel eyes 50 mt capacity in India, to pump 75% of capex into domestic growth: TV Narendran
dek: Tata Steel is eyeing 50 mt of capacity in India and will direct 75% of capex to domestic growth, with Maharashtra a possible major destination, The Hindu BusinessLine reports.
summary: According to The Hindu BusinessLine, Tata Steel is eyeing 50 mt of capacity in India and plans to put 75% of its capex into domestic growth. Managing Director and CEO T V Narendran said Maharashtra could become a major growth destination. He said the company is exploring greenfield opportunities alongside expansion at existing facilities. The excerpt gives no timeline.
keyFacts: 75% of capex to go into domestic growth
Maharashtra could emerge as a major growth destination
Greenfield opportunities being explored alongside brownfield expansion
whyItMatters: The statement confirms that India is the clear priority in Tata Steel's capital allocation.
implications: Readers should watch for site announcements in Maharashtra and for how the longer-term ambition squares with the delayed near-term target.
publisherExcerpt: Managing Director and CEO T V Narendran said Maharashtra could emerge as a major growth destination, with the company exploring greenfield opportunities alongside expansion at existing facilities.
